properties.name: Thickness
properties.description: Sheet metal thickness. 0 builds the air space as a solid body instead of a hollow shell

properties.name: InsulationThickness
properties.description: Insulation thickness wrapped around the outside of the fitting; 0 disables insulation

properties.name: TrimNeck
properties.description: Length of the straight collar between the fitting and the duct. 0 uses a quarter of the duct size

properties.name: FrameWidth
properties.description: Width of the frame around the opening. 0 leaves the frame out

properties.name: FrameDepth
properties.description: Depth of the frame along the duct

properties.name: LossMode
properties.description: How the loss is given: a coefficient K, or a fixed pressure drop from the maker's data

properties.name: LossCoefficient
properties.description: Pressure-loss coefficient K, referenced to velocity at the neck (the grille alone)

properties.name: DamperLossCoefficient
properties.description: Coefficient of the damper behind the grille at its present setting, added to LossCoefficient

properties.name: NeckSize
properties.description: Equivalent neck diameter the loss coefficient refers to. Used for the loss only, not for the shape

properties.name: PressureDrop
properties.description: Pressure drop in Pa at the design flow, used when LossMode is Fixed pressure drop

properties.name: FlangeHeight
properties.description: Height of the transverse flange at each duct connection

properties.name: FlangeThickness
properties.description: Thickness of the transverse flange; 0 draws no flanges

properties.name: ShowFlange1
properties.description: Include the flange at the duct connection

properties.name: FacePattern
properties.description: How the face is drawn: single deflection (one row of blades), double deflection (two rows, square to each other), egg crate (a grid) or a perforated plate

properties.name: BladeOrientation
properties.description: Direction of the front blades: horizontal (along the face width) or vertical

properties.name: FaceThickness
properties.description: Thickness of the face frame (0 = worked out from the face size)

properties.name: BladeSpacing
properties.description: Distance between blades (0 = worked out from the face size)

properties.name: BladeDepth
properties.description: Blade depth, front to back (0 = worked out from the face size)

properties.name: BladeThickness
properties.description: Blade thickness (0 = worked out from the face size)

properties.name: BladeAngle
properties.description: Deflection of the front blades from straight through

properties.name: HoleDiameter
properties.description: Perforated: hole diameter (0 = worked out from the face size)

properties.name: HolePitch
properties.description: Perforated: distance between hole centres (0 = worked out from the face size)

properties.name: DamperBladeAngle
properties.description: Angle of the damper blades behind the face, from fully open
